title: My AI coach told me to back off

pip._note: Where your face sits in the twin video, as fractions of the frame. Used to crop the circle bubble shown over full-screen cards.

beats.say: My AI coach just told me to back off. Five days before my race.
beats.caption: My AI coach just told me to BACK OFF. 5 days before my race.

beats.say: Here's the setup. My Garmin and Strava both feed into intervals dot I C U, which turns every ride into fitness, fatigue and form.
beats.caption: Here's the setup. Garmin and Strava both feed into intervals.icu, which turns every ride into fitness, fatigue and form.

beats.say: Then I connected an AI coach to it. It reads my power, heart rate and training load every single day.
beats.caption: Then I connected an AI coach to it. It reads my power, heart rate and training load every single day.

beats.say: This week I rode seven hours and two hundred and thirty nine kilometres. Fitness, seventy two. Fatigue, seventy seven. Form, minus five.
beats.caption: This week: 7 hours, 239 km. Fitness 72. Fatigue 77. Form minus 5.

beats.say: The verdict? Keep it light. Stay fresh. If I hold back now, I start my race on the seventh of November at plus fourteen form. Right in the sweet spot.
beats.caption: The verdict? Keep it light. Stay fresh. Hold back now and I start race day at +14 form. Right in the sweet spot.

beats.say: And the work is paying off. My one hour power is up four percent in three months.
beats.caption: And the work is paying off. My 1-hour power is up 4% in three months.

beats.say: Garmin, Strava, intervals, and an AI coach on top. Comment COACH and I'll send you my exact setup.
beats.caption: Garmin + Strava + intervals.icu + an AI coach. Comment COACH and I'll send you my setup.
